title: Back Extension
summary: A hip extension on a 45° or horizontal bench, for the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for lower back (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly lower back total.
Library rating 0.7 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.6 for hamstrings (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Set the pad just below your hip bones and lock your heels in.
Raise up until your body is in a straight line.

form_cues.cue: Rise until your body is in a straight line
Round your upper back slightly to work the glutes more, or keep it flat to work the lower back.

mistakes.text: Swinging up and overarching at the top.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less lower-back work, Better isolation, More stable.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Less lower-back work, Peak-contraction focus.
